A full-page illustration plate from a 19th-century adventure book about the sea. Technique: a copper-plate engraving with etching, printed in a single dark sepia-brown ink on plain white paper. Everything is built only from engraved lines: long parallel hatching, cross-hatching in two or three directions for the darks, swelling lines that are thick in the shadows and taper to hair-thin points in the light, short flicks and stipple dots for stone and rock, contour lines that follow the forms. The tone values come only from the thickness and spacing of the lines: no grey wash, no aquatint, no tonal gradients, no airbrush, no smudged pencil shading, no colour; between the lines the paper stays white. Printed in pure black ink on pure white paper: between the lines the paper is pure white, no tinted ground, no brown or sepia toning, no red, no colour at all. Bold, widely spaced engraved lines like a coarse steel engraving for an illustrated weekly: about 150 lines across the height of the picture, every line clearly separated from the next by white paper, the lines swelling to fill the darks and thinning out in the light. The sky is ruled with long, perfectly even horizontal lines, thick at the top of the sky and thinning out towards a light band at the horizon; the low clouds are shaped only by thicker and thinner ruling and a few contour lines. The calm sea is drawn with long horizontal, slightly wavy lines with white gaps for the reflections. Nocturne mood with strong contrast: deep cross-hatched darks in the cottage, the rocks and the boat hulls; bare white paper only at the lights, the horizon band and the reflections. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a painting, not a pencil drawing, not a woodcut, not a cartoon, not a postcard. No aged paper texture, no stains, no frame, no border line, no plate mark, no caption.

Composition for a wide game screen; the picture will later be cropped to a wide panoramic strip, so keep every important element between 15 % and 85 % of the picture height: above that only ruled sky, below that only plain quay paving. The viewpoint is close to the near quay, at the eye height of a small character: a character standing on the near quay will be about 30 % of the picture height tall, so everything on the near quay is large. The near quay paving is a band across the whole width from about 70 % of the picture height to the bottom edge; the character will walk along it at about 82 % of the height from the left edge to the middle, so keep the left two thirds of the near quay free and calm. In the near foreground at the right (72 to 98 % of the width), standing on the near quay at 82 % of the height: two large barrels, each about a quarter of the picture height tall, a stack of crates and a coil of rope. The iron lantern on its wooden post stands at the back edge of the near quay at about 30 % of the width, the post about half the picture height tall, the lantern itself against open sky. The stone cottage stands further back on the left (0 to 22 % of the width), small enough that its roof and chimney are fully in the picture, the chimney top at about 20 % of the picture height against open sky. The short wooden jetty with the two moored boats lies in the middle distance (35 to 65 % of the width), the horizon at about 50 % of the picture height. The lighthouse on its rocky headland stands in the distance at about 82 % of the width, its top at about 20 % of the picture height, its lamp against open sky. Wide areas of open ruled sky above the jetty and of calm open water in front of it.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

The lighthouse lamp, the lantern and the lit window are only small areas of bare white paper, without any beam or rays of light; the chimney without smoke; no birds in the sky. Light beam, smoke and gulls are animated separately in the game.

Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
